messages:
Maya: Heads up — PR #4823 preview is rendering oddly in the Console docs. Dashboard widgets are showing raw JSON blobs in the preview pane and the trace hook example still uses the old param name `trace_id` (we now use `trace_id_hex`). I'm going to revert the preview commit on the branch until we figure out the root cause.
Alex: Ack. Can you paste a minimal repro or screenshot? I couldn't repro when I ran `yarn docs:serve` locally.
Maya: Pasted below — the preview build on netlify shows the widgets as a collapsed JSON string. Copy/paste from the browser console:```json
{"widget": "latency_heatmap", "data": [{"bucket":10,"p50":120},{"bucket":20,"p50":180}], "renderHints": {"format":"raw"}}
```
Tomas: That JSON looks fine. My hunch: last week's markdown renderer bump to CommonMark v2 changed how fenced code blocks with a language tag are sanitized -> our mkdocs plugin might be stripping the `data-` attrs we rely on to render the widget preview. I'll repro by running the same renderer locally against the branch.
Priya: Also noticed the Node tracehook example in the same doc still uses the old param names (`trace_id`) and the Python example uses `traceid` (no underscore). We should standardize to `trace_id_hex` in all SDK examples and add a short migration note. Assign me to update the examples?
Maya: Yes please, Priya. One more thing — the cost/latency dashboard images got swapped in the embed order (looks like asset filenames changed).
Alex: I can take the screenshots. Quick ask: does the PR include the golden screenshots folder? If not, please push the new images into `docs/assets/console-screens/` and ping me here so I can upload the optimized PNGs.
deploy-bot: PR 4823 branch 'docs/console-fix' preview deploy failed: 422 ImageNotFound: assets/console-screenshot-3.png. See netlify logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/32211/logs
Tomas: OK — I'll add a pre-merge check in the docs CI to validate that all referenced assets exist and that image paths are relative. I'll add a small mkdocs plugin step to the existing pipeline.
Priya: I'll do the SDK example updates in a small follow-up PR (Node + Python). I can include a code diff snippet like:```diff
- client.trace({ trace_id: 'abcd' })
+ client.trace({ trace_id_hex: '0xabcd' })
```
Maya: Plan: 1) I revert the preview-only commit on the PR branch to unblock other changes; 2) Tomas adds the asset-existence lint and pushes a quick fix; 3) Priya opens PR for SDK example renames + migration blurb; 4) Alex uploads the missing screenshots to `docs/assets/console-screens/`; 5) re-open a consolidated PR for final review. Any objections?
Alex: :thumbsup: I'll upload the images this afternoon and post the file names here.
Tomas: Also propose we add a short 'Migration: trace hook param rename' note under the trace hooks docs, with a tiny before/after snippet and a link to the SDK changelog. That should reduce incoming support tickets.
Priya: Good call — I'll draft the migration paragraph and drop it into my PR.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll mark the PR as 'changes requested' and leave a checklist in the PR description. Tagging @eng-oncall for visibility in case there are any production telemetry implications.
eng-oncall: Noted — ping if you see any spans dropped or unusual error rates after the docs previews are live.
Maya: Action items created: `docs#4823/revert-preview` (Maya), `docs-ci/asset-lint` (Tomas), `sdk/tracehook-param-rename` (Priya), `assets/upload-console-screens` (Alex). I'll follow up tomorrow with a short sync if anything blocks. Thanks everyone.
